meta.name: PBDS Material Machine Contract
meta.rule: This is a deterministic compiled mirror of approved Figma M1-M5 canon. Figma remains visual authority. Missing or conflicting inputs fail closed.

M2.4.structure: DEVICE SHELL / BEZEL + CONTEXTUAL SCREEN CONTENT
M2.4.boundary: MATERIAL DISTINCT FROM CANVAS / PAPER / STONE / METAL

M2.6.priority: OVERLAP / OCCLUSION / CONTACT DEPTH / REFLECTION / SCALE BEFORE VISIBLE SHADOW

M2.7.mechanisms: SEAM LIGHT / EDGE LIGHT / RIM LIGHT / PROOF SIGNAL
M2.7.fixedValues: COLOR FIXED; EFFECT / OPACITY / GEOMETRY VALUES INSTANCE-CONTEXTUAL

M2.8.role: SELECTIVE PREMIUM SURFACE + DEPTH / HAZE / DISTANCE

M3.R1.objects: 1 thesis + 1 evidence + 1 signal edge + 1 CTA cluster + 1 metric band
M3.R1.required: kicker + headline + body + primary evidence + CTA cluster + metric band
M3.R1.allowedPrimitives: M2.1 + one of M2.3/M2.4/M2.5 + M2.7; M2.2/M2.6/M2.8 optional

M3.R2.objects: 1 thesis + 1 evidence + 1 signal edge + 1 CTA cluster + 1 metric band
M3.R2.required: kicker + headline + body + primary evidence + CTA cluster + metric band
M3.R2.allowedPrimitives: M2.1 + one of M2.3/M2.4/M2.5 + M2.7; M2.2/M2.6/M2.8 optional

M3.R3.objects: 1 primary UI plane + 1 subordinate M2.3 paper plane + 1 signal edge + 1 divider + 2 text groups
M3.R3.required: metadata + title + body + proof label + value + context + source
M3.R3.allowedPrimitives: M2.1 + M2.3 + M2.5 + M2.6 + M2.7; M2.8 contextual
M3.R3.prohibit: duplicate rounded-card silhouette; fewer or more than 2 visible material planes

M3.R5.objects: 1 environment + 1 oversized thesis + 1 overlapping proof cluster (2–4 objects) + atmosphere 1–2 + signals 1–3 + 1 lower proof/CTA band + 1 exact asterisk crop
M3.R5.zones: ENVIRONMENT 100% · LEFT thesis · RIGHT cluster 35–70% · LOWER band ≤25%
M3.R5.allowedPrimitives: M2.1 + M2.2 + M2.5 + M2.7 + M2.8 required; M2.3/M2.4/M2.6 contextual
M3.R5.prohibit: centered grid; left/right reversal; standalone decorative floating asterisk; isolated metric card plus decorative planes

M4.A1.required: bindingId · role · subjectIdentity · sourceKind · sourceRef · approvalState

M4.A2.slots: M3.R1 evidence | M3.R2 evidence | M3.R5 cluster object
M4.A2.required: bindingId · m3Slot · sourceKind · shellSourceRef · screenContentSourceRef · approvalState

M4.A3.slots: M3.R1 evidence | M3.R2 evidence | M3.R3 subordinate paper plane | M3.R5 contextual object
M4.A3.required: bindingId · m3Slot · planeMode · frontSourceRef · backSourceRef? · approvalState

M4.A4.missing: FAIL CLOSED — M3.R5 cannot compile to a production instance without an approved clean environment binding

M4.A5.required: bindingId · consumerRef · sourceKind · markSourceRef · variantSourceRef? · approvalState
M4.A5.variantRule: exact approved source variant only; no silent recolor/redraw/trace/retype

M4.A6.scope: only named fields already defined by approved M3/canonical consumers
M4.A6.required: bindingId · consumerRef · fieldMap · sourceKind · sourceRef? · approvalState
M4.A6.proofRule: do not invent, guess, silently round, or substitute factual proof
M4.A6.sampleRule: sample strings are examples only, never universal defaults
M4.A6.missing: FAIL CLOSED for required semantic field

B1.missing: FAIL CLOSED — never infer recipe transform from nearest mode or non-canonical study

R1.transform: mobile stack; tablet stack with metric sibling overlay; small_web split; web split
R1.prohibit: metric band becoming child of device proof; proportional text shrink below canonical roles

R2.transform: mobile stack; tablet stack with metric sibling overlay; small_web split; web split
R2.prohibit: generic black card/glow/glass substitute; light binding substitution

R3.transform: mobile vertical 2-plane centered-text reflow; tablet/small_web/web native 760×300
R3.prohibit: one-card fallback; remove paper plane; third plane; proportional type shrink

R4.transform: mobile vertical 3-row; tablet compressed 720×150; small_web/web native 770×150
R4.prohibit: drop metric/divider; card/depth; internal magenta; type below 50/11

R5.transform: mobile asymmetric vertical; tablet/small_web/web directional 16:9 grammar
R5.direction: mobile upper-left thesis + lower-right cluster + lower band; other modes left thesis + right cluster + lower band
R5.prohibit: center-stack; reverse hierarchy; remove overlap/asterisk/lower band; invent environment

primary.rule: solid Brand Magenta primary in every tone and breakpoint; black-fill and outline-only primary variants prohibited

mobile.structure: ONE centered primary pill + ONE centered secondary text action
